Diag.AboutText: IPA PILOTDREDD is an App Store purchase library, IPA downloader for your own Apple ID and iPhone/iPad installer. Author: PILOTDREDD. Powered by ipatool-cpp and libimobiledevice, based on IPA Downloader (kda2495). Use only with your own purchases.
Diag.UpdateAvailableText: Open the releases page in your browser?
Diag.LatestUpstream: Latest IPA Downloader (upstream) release: {0}. IPA PILOTDREDD and IPA Downloader version numbers are independent — check the release notes for ipatool updates.
Diag.Hint.BinaryRoot: Put the MainApp folder next to the app (it is in the release archive) or choose the binaries folder in Settings.
Diag.Hint.Ipatool: ipatool not found. Check MainApp/windows_amd64 (extract the whole release archive) or choose the binaries folder in Settings.
Diag.Hint.DeviceToolsWin: idevice_id.exe, ideviceinfo.exe, ideviceinstaller.exe and their DLLs are needed in MainApp/windows_amd64.
Diag.Hint.DeviceToolsLinux: Install the libimobiledevice-utils and ideviceinstaller packages (or equivalents for your distribution).
Diag.Hint.IdeviceInfo: Without ideviceinfo the iOS version and model are unknown and the minimum iOS check is impossible.
Diag.Hint.Dlls: DLLs are missing in MainApp/windows_amd64 — extract the release archive again.
Diag.Hint.AppleDriver: Install “Apple Devices” from the Microsoft Store or iTunes — without the driver the device is not visible over USB.
Diag.Hint.AppsList: Click “Update lists” or copy Files/AppsList.txt from 4.2.
Diag.Hint.Writable: No write access. Choose another folder or run the app from your user folder.
Diag.Hint.Session: Sign in on the “Apple ID” page.
Diag.Hint.FreeSpace: Free up space: some IPAs are larger than a gigabyte.

Devices.ProblemsText: iOS rejects apps whose signature or iOS version does not fit. IPA PILOTDREDD does not re-sign apps.
Sign.Hint.AppStore: App Store build. It installs; it launches if the device is signed in to the Apple ID that purchased it.
Sign.Hint.AdHoc: Installs only on devices whose UDID is in the profile, until it expires.
Sign.Hint.Development: Installs only on devices from the developer profile, until it expires.
Sign.Hint.Enterprise: Enterprise signature: installs on any device while the certificate is valid and not revoked. You may need to trust the developer in iOS Settings.
Sign.Hint.Distribution: App Store submission signature — cannot be installed on a device. Re-signing is required.
Sign.Hint.Unsigned: No signature — iOS will not install this app without re-signing.
Sign.Hint.Decrypted: The executable is decrypted, the Apple signature is broken. Re-signing is required (Sideloadly, AltStore, etc.).
Sign.Hint.Unknown: No profile, the signature type could not be determined. Installation may fail.
Sign.Problem.Decrypted: decrypted IPA without signature, needs re-signing
Sign.Problem.Distribution: App Store submission signature, not installable
Sign.Problem.NoDevice: device UDID is not in the signing profile
Sign.Problem.AppStore: App Store build: launches only with the purchaser Apple ID on the device
Log.ExternalRemoved: Removed from the list (files on disk were not deleted): {0}
